add-filled-arc-to-pdf-graph.title: Create PDF with Filled Arc Graph
add-filled-arc-to-pdf-graph.description: Shows how to generate a PDF, add a Graph canvas, draw an Arc shape, fill it with a custom color, and save the document.

add-unfilled-arc-with-custom-stroke.title: Add Unfilled Dashed Arc to PDF Graph
add-unfilled-arc-with-custom-stroke.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a Graph object, configures line width and dash pattern, and draws an unfilled half‑circle arc (0‑180°) using Aspose.Pdf.

add-filled-circle-to-pdf-graph.title: Add Filled Circle to PDF Using Aspose.Pdf Graph
add-filled-circle-to-pdf-graph.description: Demonstrates how to draw a filled circle on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's Graph and Ellipse classes.

create-bezier-curve-in-pdf-graph.title: Create Bezier Curve in PDF Graph
create-bezier-curve-in-pdf-graph.description: Shows how to draw a Bezier curve with four control points inside an Aspose.Pdf Graph and set its stroke color.

draw-straight-line-in-pdf-graph.title: Draw Straight Line on PDF Page
draw-straight-line-in-pdf-graph.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a page, and uses a Graph container to draw a straight line with specified start and end coordinates, setting its colour and thickness before saving the file.

add-multi-colored-line-segments-to-pdf-g.title: Add Colored Line Segments to a Graph in PDF
add-multi-colored-line-segments-to-pdf-g.description: Shows how to create a PDF, add a titled graph, and draw consecutive line segments with varying colors to represent a continuous data series.

add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill-to-pdf-g.title: Add Rounded Rectangle with Fill Color to PDF
add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill-to-pdf-g.description: Demonstrates how to insert a rectangle shape into a PDF page using a Graph container, set rounded corners, and apply a solid fill color.

add-filled-rectangle-with-dashed-border.title: Add Filled Rectangle with Dashed Border to PDF Graph
add-filled-rectangle-with-dashed-border.description: The example creates a PDF document, adds a Graph container, and draws a filled rectangle with a custom dashed border inside the graph.

add-ellipse-to-pdf-page.title: Create an Ellipse in a PDF with Specified Radii and Stroke Color
add-ellipse-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to add an ellipse shape to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, specifying its center, horizontal and vertical radii, and setting the stroke color.

add-centered-graph-to-pdf-page.title: Add Centered Graph to PDF Page
add-centered-graph-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to create a Graph object, set its horizontal and vertical alignment to center, add it to a page's Paragraphs collection, and save the PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

align-graph-to-left-margin-pdf.title: Add Graph to PDF with Left Margin Offset
align-graph-to-left-margin-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert an Aspose.Pdf Graph into an existing PDF page and align it to the left margin using a specified offset.

set-graph-dimensions-pdf.title: Set Graph Width and Height in PDF
set-graph-dimensions-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a Graph with explicit width and height, add a line shape, and save the result as a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

create-dimension-line-in-pdf-graph.title: Create Dimension-Specific Line in PDF
create-dimension-line-in-pdf-graph.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Drawing Graph to draw a line with exact coordinates and styling on a PDF page.

create-dimension-specific-rectangle-pdf.title: Draw a Dimension‑Specific Rectangle on a PDF Page
create-dimension-specific-rectangle-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, create a Graph that spans the page, and add a rectangle with custom border settings using Aspose.Pdf drawing classes.

check-adjust-shape-bounds-pdf.title: Adjust Rectangle Shape Bounds Within PDF Pages
check-adjust-shape-bounds-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page's Graph objects, and repositions rectangle shapes so they stay inside the page boundaries before saving the document.

iterate-graph-shapes-bounding-boxes.title: Iterate Graph Shapes and Log Bounding Boxes in PDF
iterate-graph-shapes-bounding-boxes.description: The example opens a PDF, walks through each page's graph objects, enumerates the shapes within those graphs, and writes the bounding box coordinates (or points) of rectangles, lines, and curves to the console.

rotate-graph-in-pdf.title: Rotate Graph Element in PDF
rotate-graph-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates creating a graph in a PDF, applying a rotation angle via GraphInfo, adding a line shape, and saving the result using Aspose.Pdf.

translate-graph-position-in-pdf.title: Translate Graph Shape in PDF
translate-graph-position-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to move a graph element, such as a rectangle, by applying horizontal and vertical offsets using Aspose.Pdf's Graph and Rectangle classes.

non-uniform-scale-graph.title: Non‑Uniformly Scale Graph Image in PDF
non-uniform-scale-graph.description: Shows how to replace a graph image on a PDF page with a version that is scaled differently on the X and Y axes using Aspose.Pdf.

skew-graph-x-axis.title: Skew a Graph on the X Axis in a PDF
skew-graph-x-axis.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a Graph container, apply an X‑axis skew, add a rectangle shape, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

clip-graph-to-rectangle-pdf.title: Clip Graph Shapes to a Rectangle in PDF
clip-graph-to-rectangle-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to emulate a clipping region for a Graph by adding a background rectangle and drawing shapes that appear only within that defined area.

add-semi-transparent-rectangle-using-tra.title: Draw Semi-Transparent Rectangle Using Graph
add-semi-transparent-rectangle-using-tra.description: Demonstrates how to create a Graph that covers a PDF page, add a rectangle shape with a semi‑transparent fill using ARGB values, and save the document.

add-shadow-effect-to-filled-rectangle.title: Add Shadow Effect to a Filled Rectangle in a PDF Graph
add-shadow-effect-to-filled-rectangle.description: Demonstrates how to emulate a shadow for a rectangle inside an Aspose.Pdf Graph by drawing an offset semi‑transparent rectangle before the main shape.

create-custom-star-shape-pdf.title: Create Custom Star Shape in PDF
create-custom-star-shape-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to draw a star polygon with a configurable number of points and fill it with a color using Aspose.Pdf's Graph and Line objects.

add-regular-hexagon-to-pdf-graph.title: Add Hexagon Shape to PDF Graph
add-regular-hexagon-to-pdf-graph.description: Demonstrates how to create a Graph, draw a regular six‑sided polygon (hexagon) using a Line shape, set its border color and thickness, and embed it in a PDF document.

insert-dashed-polyline-annotation.title: Insert Dashed Polyline into PDF Graph
insert-dashed-polyline-annotation.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a full‑page graph, defines multiple vertices, and draws a polyline composed of dashed line segments between those vertices.

add-text-inside-graph.title: Add Text at Specific Coordinates to PDF Graph
add-text-inside-graph.description: Shows how to insert a text fragment into an existing PDF, set its font family, size, and color, and position it at exact coordinates on a page that contains a graph.

add-background-image-and-graph-to-pdf.title: Apply Background Image and Overlay Shapes in PDF
add-background-image-and-graph-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add an image as a background stamp on a PDF page and then draw vector shapes (rectangle, ellipse, line) on top using Aspose.Pdf's Graph container.

insert-scaled-rotated-image-into-pdf.title: Insert and Transform External Image in PDF
insert-scaled-rotated-image-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding an external image as an ImageStamp, scaling it proportionally, and rotating it by a specified angle before saving the document.

add-filled-arc-with-radial-gradient.title: Add Filled Arc with Radial Gradient to PDF Graph
add-filled-arc-with-radial-gradient.description: Shows how to create a PDF graph, draw an arc with specific start and sweep angles, and fill it using a radial gradient shading.

create-new-pdf-single-page.title: Create PDF with a Single Page
create-new-pdf-single-page.description: Shows how to create a new PDF document, add a default‑size page (A4), and save the file using Aspose.Pdf.

add-full-size-graph-to-pdf-page.title: Create a Full-Page Graph and Draw a Rectangle in PDF
add-full-size-graph-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to instantiate a Graph object that matches a PDF page's width and height and add a styled rectangle shape to it using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rectangle-solid-red-fill-to-pdf-grap.title: Add Solid Red Rectangle to PDF Using Graph
add-rectangle-solid-red-fill-to-pdf-grap.description: Shows how to create a PDF, add a full‑page Graph, and draw a rectangle with absolute coordinates filled solid red and without a border.

create-semi-transparent-ellipse-fill.title: Create Semi-Transparent Ellipse in PDF
create-semi-transparent-ellipse-fill.description: Shows how to draw an ellipse with a semi‑transparent fill by using Color.FromArgb to set the alpha channel, and save the result to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.

insert-centered-textfragment-rectangle.title: Insert Centered TextFragment into PDF Rectangle
insert-centered-textfragment-rectangle.description: Opens an existing PDF, defines a rectangle, computes its center point, and adds a 'Hello World' TextFragment centered within that rectangle before saving the document.

add-shapes-with-bounds-checking.title: Catch Out-of-Bounds PDF Shape Annotations
add-shapes-with-bounds-checking.description: Demonstrates adding rectangle (square) annotations to PDF pages with Aspose.Pdf while catching bounds‑checking exceptions and logging the coordinates of shapes that exceed page limits.

add-non-overlapping-rectangles-to-pdf-gr.title: Add Non-Overlapping Rectangles to PDF with Bounds Checking
add-non-overlapping-rectangles-to-pdf-gr.description: Demonstrates adding multiple rectangle annotations to a PDF while ensuring they do not overlap by performing bounds checking before placement.

create-graph-with-rectangle-and-ellipse.title: Create Graph with Rectangles and Ellipses in PDF
create-graph-with-rectangle-and-ellipse.description: Demonstrates how to build a Graph container, add rectangle and ellipse shapes with solid fill colors, and embed the graph into a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-to-memorystream-and-save-to-f.title: Export PDF to MemoryStream and Save to Disk
export-pdf-to-memorystream-and-save-to-f.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, saving it into a MemoryStream, and then writing the stream to a file on disk.

add-graph-with-shapes-to-pdf.title: Add Graph with Axes and Data Points to PDF
add-graph-with-shapes-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, adding a new page, and drawing a simple graph with axes, data point markers, connecting lines, and a title using Aspose.Pdf.

add-graph-rectangle-watermark-to-pdf.title: Insert Graph Image and Watermark into Multiple PDFs
add-graph-rectangle-watermark-to-pdf.description: The example iterates through all PDF files in a folder, adds a graph image stamp and a semi‑transparent text watermark to each page, and saves the modified PDFs to an output directory.

add-gradient-ellipse-graphs-to-pdfs.title: Add Ellipse Graph to PDFs Concurrently
add-gradient-ellipse-graphs-to-pdfs.description: Loads each PDF, adds a Graph containing an ellipse shape, and saves the modified file while processing multiple PDFs in parallel using Parallel.ForEach.

configure-graph-border-add-rectangle.title: Configure Rectangle Border Style in PDF using Graph
configure-graph-border-add-rectangle.description: Demonstrates how to set line width, dash pattern, and color for a rectangle border by configuring GraphInfo before adding the shape to a PDF page.

build-reusable-graph-for-pdf-pages.title: Create Predefined Bar‑Chart Graph on a PDF Page
build-reusable-graph-for-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to build a simple bar‑chart using Aspose.Pdf core objects, add axes, bars, titles and labels, and return the Graph instance for any PDF page.

serialize-pdf-graph-to-byte-array.title: Serialize PDF with Line Graph to Byte Array
serialize-pdf-graph-to-byte-array.description: Creates a PDF containing a simple line graph using Aspose.Pdf, stores it in a MemoryStream, and returns the PDF as a byte array for network transmission.

toggle-graph-bounds-check-mode.title: Toggle Graph Bounds Checking Based on User Preference
toggle-graph-bounds-check-mode.description: Demonstrates how to respect a user setting to either ignore or enforce bounds checking for an Aspose.Pdf.Drawing.Graph by performing manual validation before adding it to a PDF page.

create-bar-graph-with-legend.title: Create PDF Bar Chart with Legend using Aspose.Pdf
create-bar-graph-with-legend.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF report that contains a simple bar chart made of colored rectangles and a corresponding legend, using Aspose.Pdf's Graph, Rectangle and TextFragment classes.

add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill.title: Add Rounded Rectangle with Fill to PDF
add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill.description: Shows how to create a rectangle with rounded corners, apply a solid fill color, and place it on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

create-rotate-ellipse-pdf-graph.title: Add Rotated Ellipse to PDF Graph
create-rotate-ellipse-pdf-graph.description: Demonstrates creating a Graph, adding an Ellipse shape, applying fill and stroke colors, rotating it 45 degrees, and saving the result as a PDF.

combine-multiple-graphs-pdf-collage.title: Combine Multiple Graph Images into a PDF Collage
combine-multiple-graphs-pdf-collage.description: Shows how to place several PNG graph images at specific coordinates on a single PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp and save the result.

add-semi-transparent-rectangle.title: Add Gradient Rectangle with Alpha Transparency to PDF
add-semi-transparent-rectangle.description: Demonstrates how to draw a rectangle filled with a vertical axial gradient that transitions from transparent to opaque using the alpha channel. The example uses Aspose.Pdf to create the gradient, apply it via a PatternColorSpace, and embed the shape in a PDF page.

measure-ellipse-bounding-box.title: Measure Ellipse Bounding Box in a PDF
measure-ellipse-bounding-box.description: Demonstrates creating an ellipse inside a Graph, applying a fill color, and programmatically obtaining its bounding box coordinates before saving the PDF.

create-multi-page-pdf-with-full-page-gra.title: Multi‑Page PDF with Full‑Page Graphs
create-multi-page-pdf-with-full-page-gra.description: Creates a PDF containing multiple pages, each with a Graph that fills the entire page and displays a simple bar chart.

configure-shape-fill-colors-json-pdf-gra.title: Create Bar Chart with Configurable Fill Colors using Aspose.Pdf
configure-shape-fill-colors-json-pdf-gra.description: Shows how to load a JSON configuration to define default fill colors for shapes and use those colors while drawing a simple bar chart in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.

add-dashed-rectangle-to-graph.title: Add Dashed Rectangle to PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
add-dashed-rectangle-to-graph.description: Demonstrates how to draw a rectangle with a 2‑point black border and a dashed line style on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

test-out-of-bounds-rectangle-throws-exce.title: Test Adding Out‑of‑Bounds Rectangle to Graph
test-out-of-bounds-rectangle-throws-exce.description: Shows how to write a unit test that adds a rectangle with coordinates outside the page limits to a Graph and asserts that an ArgumentOutOfRangeException is thrown.

batch-insert-company-logo-graph-into-pdf.title: Batch Insert Graph and Logo into PDFs
batch-insert-company-logo-graph-into-pdf.description: Shows how to iterate over PDF files in a folder, add a predefined graph image, draw a rectangle shape, and place a company logo inside the rectangle using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-graph.title: Create PDF with In-Memory Graph
create-pdf-with-graph.description: Demonstrates generating a PDF in memory using Aspose.Pdf, adding a simple line graph via the Graph class, and returning the PDF as a byte array.

create-proportional-graphs-pdf.title: Create Proportional Graphs on PDF Pages
create-proportional-graphs-pdf.description: Shows how to add a Graph to each PDF page and draw rectangle, circle, and lines sized proportionally to the page dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

map-shape-identifiers-to-fill-colors.title: Map Shape IDs to Fill Colors in PDF Graph
map-shape-identifiers-to-fill-colors.description: Demonstrates using a Dictionary to associate shape identifiers with fill colors and applying those colors when creating rectangles and ellipses in an Aspose.Pdf Graph, then saving the result as a PDF.

ellipse-with-transparent-fill-and-center.title: Add Ellipse with Transparent Fill and Centered Text to PDF
ellipse-with-transparent-fill-and-center.description: Demonstrates how to draw an ellipse with a thick border and semi‑transparent fill using a Graph, and place a centered TextFragment inside it on a PDF page.

create-pdf-graph-styled-text.title: Create PDF Graph with Shapes and Text
create-pdf-graph-styled-text.description: Shows how to generate a PDF that contains a graph made of circles and rectangles, each labeled with text using different fonts and sizes.

scale-graph-shapes-150-percent.title: Scale Graph Shapes by 150% Using Transform
scale-graph-shapes-150-percent.description: Demonstrates how to use the Graph object's Transform (ScalingRateX/Y) to enlarge rectangle and ellipse shapes by 150 % before adding the graph to a PDF page.

add-rectangle-with-shadow-to-pdf.title: Add Rectangle with Shadow to PDF
add-rectangle-with-shadow-to-pdf.description: Shows how to draw a rectangle and a semi‑transparent offset shadow on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's Graph and Shape objects.

create-pdf-graph-border-colors.title: Draw Circles with Border Colors from a Lookup Table
create-pdf-graph-border-colors.description: Creates a PDF, adds a page, and draws four circles whose border colors are retrieved from a dictionary lookup table. Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's Graph, Ellipse, GraphInfo, and Color classes to set stroke colors and save the document.

insert-graph-into-pdf-footer.title: Add Bar Chart to PDF Footer
insert-graph-into-pdf-footer.description: Demonstrates creating an A4 PDF with 1‑inch margins and drawing a simple bar chart positioned in the page footer using Aspose.Pdf's Graph and TextFragment classes.

create-horizontal-bar-chart-pdf.title: Create Horizontal Bar Chart with Rectangles in PDF
create-horizontal-bar-chart-pdf.description: Demonstrates generating a PDF, adding a page, using a Graph container, and looping to draw ten rectangles with incremental X positions to form a simple horizontal bar chart, then saving the document.

create-pdf-graph-filled-outline-shapes.title: Create PDF Graph with Filled and Unfilled Shapes
create-pdf-graph-filled-outline-shapes.description: Shows how to draw a filled rectangle and a stroke‑only ellipse using Aspose.Pdf Graph, and add a title to the PDF.

export-graph-to-pdf.title: Export Graph to PDF with Aspose.Pdf
export-graph-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF document, adding a page, drawing a vector graph with a line, and saving the result as a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-circle-to-pdf-graph-gradient.title: Add Circle to PDF Graph with Gradient Fill
add-circle-to-pdf-graph-gradient.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF, adding a full‑page Graph, drawing a circle shape, applying a solid fill color (as a placeholder for a gradient) and a border, then saving the document.

add-filled-ellipse-with-gradient-to-pdf-.title: Add Filled Ellipse with Gradient Direction to PDF Graph
add-filled-ellipse-with-gradient-to-pdf-.description: Shows how to create a PDF document, add a Graph, draw an ellipse that fills the graph area, and set its fill color (with optional gradient direction).

add-polygon-gradient-fill-dashed-outline.title: Add Polygon with Gradient Fill and Dashed Outline to PDF Graph
add-polygon-gradient-fill-dashed-outline.description: Shows how to create a Graph, draw a closed polygon, fill it with an axial gradient pattern, and apply a dashed outline using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-graph-shapes.title: Create PDF with Shapes Using Graph
create-pdf-with-graph-shapes.description: Shows how to generate a PDF, add a Graph container to a page, and draw rectangle and ellipse shapes using Aspose.Pdf drawing classes.

apply-linear-gradient-ellipse.title: Apply Linear Gradient Fill to an Ellipse in PDF
apply-linear-gradient-ellipse.description: Demonstrates how to create an ellipse inside a Graph and fill it with a blue‑to‑green axial gradient using Aspose.Pdf.

ellipse-gradient-dark-gray-border.title: Create Ellipse with Dark Gray Border and Gradient‑Like Fill
ellipse-gradient-dark-gray-border.description: Demonstrates how to add an ellipse shape to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, set its stroke color to dark gray, apply a solid light‑gray fill as a gradient placeholder, and save the document.

set-rectangle-fill-opacity-argb.title: Set Rectangle Fill Opacity Using ARGB in PDF
set-rectangle-fill-opacity-argb.description: Creates a PDF, adds a rectangle shape, and sets its fill color to 50% transparent blue using an ARGB value before saving the document.

deserialize-pdf-add-labeled-graph.title: Deserialize PDF Byte Array and Add Labeled Graph
deserialize-pdf-add-labeled-graph.description: Shows how to convert a PDF to a byte array, reload it into a Document, and then add two Graph objects – a simple line and a bar graph with text labels – before saving the result.

clip-shapes-within-rectangle-graph.title: Clip Shapes Within a Rectangle Using Graph
clip-shapes-within-rectangle-graph.description: Demonstrates how to apply the Graph object's Clip property (via GraphInfo) to restrict drawing of shapes to a defined rectangular region in a PDF document.

add-square-annotations-with-bounds-valid.title: Add Square Annotations with Bounds Validation and Error Logging
add-square-annotations-with-bounds-valid.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, iterating its pages, adding square annotations defined by custom rectangle bounds, and logging detailed shape coordinates when bounds checking throws an exception.

create-ellipse-with-pattern-fill.title: Create Ellipse with Custom Fill in PDF
create-ellipse-with-pattern-fill.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a Graph container, draw an ellipse and set its fill and stroke colors (simulating a pattern) using Aspose.Pdf.

create-radial-gradient-rectangle.title: Create Radial Gradient Rectangle in PDF
create-radial-gradient-rectangle.description: Shows how to simulate a radial gradient by drawing several concentric rectangles with decreasing opacity using Aspose.Pdf's Graph and Rectangle objects.

clone-rectangle-change-fill-and-add.title: Clone Rectangle, Change Fill Color, and Add to Graph
clone-rectangle-change-fill-and-add.description: Shows how to deep‑clone an Aspose.Pdf.Drawing.Rectangle, modify its fill color, and add the cloned shape to a Graph's shape collection.

add-ellipse-gradient-simulation-center-v.title: Add Ellipse with Gradient Simulation and Center Verification
add-ellipse-gradient-simulation-center-v.description: The example creates an ellipse on a PDF page, applies a solid fill to simulate a conical gradient, and verifies that the stored gradient origin aligns with the ellipse's geometric center.

apply-texture-brush-to-ellipse.title: Apply Texture Brush to an Ellipse in PDF
apply-texture-brush-to-ellipse.description: Demonstrates how to use a texture image as a background and draw an ellipse with a transparent fill to simulate a texture brush effect using Aspose.Pdf.
